commitments.detail: Conduct one load test after hookup assignments and operating windows are approved, per S5.

No generator may be loaded beyond its rated capacity. G-1 (60 kW) will carry clinic (25 kW) plus motor pool (35 kW) for a total of 60 kW at peak. G-2 (40 kW) will carry communications (15 kW), well within its 40 kW rating.
